description: Versioned DORA and AI-assisted delivery metric definitions.

metrics.name: Lead time for changes
metrics.event_source: change and deployment events joined by change_id
metrics.window: deployment completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Exclude deployments without a first_commit_at or completed_at and report the missing count.
metrics.privacy: aggregate repository, change, and deployment identifiers only

metrics.name: Deployment frequency
metrics.window: production deployment completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count each deployment_id once; exclude retries and non-production deployments.
metrics.privacy: aggregate service and deployment identifiers only

metrics.name: Change failure rate
metrics.event_source: deployment, rollback, hotfix, failed_release, and incident events joined by deployment_id
metrics.window: production deployment completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: A deployment is failed when a linked rollback, hotfix, failed_release, or production-impacting incident is classified within the configured window.
metrics.privacy: aggregate service, deployment, and incident identifiers only

metrics.name: Time to restore service
metrics.window: incident detection in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Exclude incidents without detected_at or restored_at and report unresolved incidents separately.
metrics.privacy: aggregate service and incident identifiers only

metrics.name: Escaped defects
metrics.window: defect discovery in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count distinct defect_id values marked escaped; missing escaped classification is incomplete.
metrics.privacy: aggregate defect and service identifiers only

metrics.name: Security findings by severity
metrics.window: finding creation in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count distinct finding_id values and retain a severity breakdown; unknown severity is incomplete.
metrics.privacy: aggregate finding IDs and severity only

metrics.name: Flaky test rate
metrics.window: test run completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count test runs marked flaky divided by all test runs; unknown flaky classification is incomplete.
metrics.privacy: aggregate test run IDs only

metrics.name: Rollback rate
metrics.event_source: rollback and deployment events joined by deployment_id
metrics.window: production deployment completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count each rolled-back deployment once and divide by distinct production deployments.
metrics.privacy: aggregate service and deployment identifiers only

metrics.name: SLO attainment
metrics.window: SLO observation in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Average declared SLO attainment values; missing observations are incomplete.
metrics.privacy: aggregate service and SLO indicator only

metrics.name: Complete evidence rate
metrics.window: change completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count complete evidence records divided by all evidence records.
metrics.privacy: aggregate change identifiers only

metrics.name: Agent-suggested defect rate
metrics.window: defect discovery in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count defects marked suggested_by_agent divided by all defects.
metrics.privacy: aggregate defect and change identifiers only

metrics.name: Human rework rate
metrics.event_source: rework and change events joined by change_id
metrics.window: rework recorded in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count rework records divided by distinct changes; missing attribution is excluded and reported.
metrics.privacy: aggregate change identifiers only

metrics.name: Review acceptance rate
metrics.window: review completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count reviews accepted without another change cycle divided by all reviews.
metrics.privacy: aggregate change identifiers only

metrics.name: Scope drift rate
metrics.window: change completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count changes marked drift divided by scope records.
metrics.privacy: aggregate change identifiers only

metrics.name: Validation pass rate
metrics.window: validation completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count validations passed on the first attempt divided by validation records.
metrics.privacy: aggregate change identifiers only

metrics.name: Policy violation rate
metrics.event_source: policy_violation and change events joined by change_id
metrics.window: confirmed policy violation in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count confirmed policy violations divided by distinct changes; unconfirmed reports are not violations.
metrics.privacy: aggregate change identifiers and policy categories only

metrics.name: Average review cycles
metrics.window: review completion in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Average numeric review cycle counts; missing cycle counts are incomplete.
metrics.privacy: aggregate change identifiers only

metrics.name: Time saved or added
metrics.event_source: time_measurement and change events joined by change_id
metrics.window: declared time measurement in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Sum declared seconds_delta divided by distinct changes; the timing method must be documented.
metrics.privacy: aggregate change identifiers and declared duration only

metrics.name: AI product task quality
metrics.window: evaluated task in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Average declared task quality values; mark not applicable when no AI product is present.
metrics.privacy: aggregate evaluation identifiers only

metrics.name: AI safety rate
metrics.window: evaluated AI outcome in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Average declared safety values; mark not applicable when no AI product is present.
metrics.privacy: aggregate evaluation identifiers only

metrics.name: Appropriate abstention or escalation rate
metrics.window: evaluated AI outcome in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Average declared abstention or escalation values; mark not applicable when no AI product is present.
metrics.privacy: aggregate evaluation identifiers only

metrics.name: User-reported harms
metrics.window: aggregated harm report in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count aggregate harm values only; never retain free-form reports or personal data.
metrics.privacy: aggregate harm counts only

metrics.name: AI product cost
metrics.window: aggregated cost in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Sum declared cost values using one configured currency; mark not applicable when no AI product is present.
metrics.privacy: aggregate cost values only

metrics.name: AI product latency
metrics.window: aggregated latency observation in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Average declared latency values; declare percentile or budget in the metric plan.
metrics.privacy: aggregate latency values only

metrics.name: AI product drift
metrics.window: aggregated drift observation in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Average declared drift values against a retained baseline; mark not applicable when no AI product is present.
metrics.privacy: aggregate distribution or quality values only

metrics.name: AI incident recurrence
metrics.window: aggregated recurrence count in reporting period
metrics.missing_data_rule: Count aggregate recurrence values only; never retain incident narratives.
metrics.privacy: aggregate recurrence counts only

metrics.privacy: aggregate phase and service identifiers only
